add_definitions(-D_IMAGEHLP_SOURCE_)
include_directories(BEFORE ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/include/wine)
spec2def(imagehlp.dll imagehlp.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# imagehlp.dll is all Rust (imagehlp-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/imagehlp-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# access.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/imagehlp-rust/src/imagehlp/access.rs)
# imagehlp_main.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/imagehlp-rust/src/imagehlp/imagehlp_main.rs)
# integrity.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/imagehlp-rust/src/imagehlp/integrity.rs)
# modify.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/imagehlp-rust/src/imagehlp/modify.rs)
add_cargo_module(imagehlp imagehlp-cargo imagehlp.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE imagehlp-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)

include(c_oracle.cmake)  # the pre-flip C as <target>_c: python -m rustconv.c_oracle
